artifact_role: durable macro-only HMRA v0.1 freeze before any asset-conditioned Phase 2 result

fed_ip.note: The full current Fed text-file hash is intentionally not a durable gate because later 2026 observations can change without altering the 1919-2025 research input.

bls_cpi.transport: BLS Public Data API v1 in <=10-year chunks

model_rule_freeze.same_year_pairing_role: descriptive structural association only; no causal claim

macro_states_csv.semantic_canonicalization: JSON records in row order; object keys sorted; null for missing; year and strict_causal_return_year as integers; all other numeric values rounded to 10 decimals; strings/booleans exact

sensitivity_10y.interpretation_guard: Do not switch the primary lookback or thresholds because the sensitivity produces more attractive occupancy or later asset results.

phase2_gate.allowed_next_step: Preregister asset-source mapping, contemporaneous structural tests, strict-causal tests, gold boundary, era-conditioned comparisons and multiple-testing/interpretation rules before loading any asset outcome.
phase2_gate.forbidden_next_step: Do not directly join Damodaran/JST asset returns to HMRA states and inspect results before the Phase 2 contract exists.

revision_policy.canonical_input_hash_change: fail closed; create explicit new HMRA source-freeze version and explain revision before regenerating outcome evidence
revision_policy.generated_macro_state_hash_change: Fail closed on semantic SHA change. Raw CSV byte SHA is diagnostic only because repeated identical canonical inputs produced rare float-serialization byte drift without state/occupancy change.
revision_policy.occupancy_or_10y_agreement_change: fail closed; never repair by tuning thresholds or lookback after asset outcomes exist
revision_policy.semantic_hash_rationale: Phase 2 first asset-outcome run was blocked before asset loading because identical canonical Fed/BLS input hashes regenerated a CSV differing only at raw-byte level. Semantic hashing was introduced before any asset outcome was read.
